methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab represents institutional investment in deep AI literacy outside metro corridors, suggesting peer-to-peer learning networks could emerge regionally rather than consolidating in NoVA's existing tech ecosystem.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free community AI workshops in Hampton Roads signal grassroots skill distribution efforts that bypass platform dependency, potentially building deep capability through local peer networks rather than concentrating expertise in traditional tech hubs.

signals.title: Virginia Tech secures $20m NSF grant for AI-enabled semiconductor lab - Cleanroom Technology
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech's $20M NSF grant for AI semiconductor research concentrates advanced technical capability in the New River Valley, creating a potential excellence pocket but requiring intentional distribution mechanisms to prevent metro-rural knowledge asymmetry.

signals.title: NoVa lawmakers take AI cash while residents resist data centers - opensecrets.org
signals.signal_reading: NoVA lawmakers receiving AI lobbying funds while residents resist data centers reveals concentrated infrastructure decision-making power in metro regions, with local pushback suggesting capability benefits may not distribute even within the hub itself.

signals.title: ‘Shaping our future’: Company powering AI data centers invests $50+ million in Henrico, adding 200 jobs - WWBT
signals.signal_reading: A $50M data center investment adding 200 jobs in Henrico reinforces Richmond's position as a secondary AI infrastructure hub, but infrastructure jobs alone don't guarantee deep AI literacy unless coupled with workforce development initiatives.
